title: Deep Learning for Image Captioning
description: Design of a workflow combining supervised models (CNN for feature extraction) and unsupervised learning techniques (CAE auto-encoders, VAE) to generate compact and relevant representations. Implementation of a subtitling system based on a Par-Inject architecture with RNN and transfer learning.

title: Redesigning WAN Network Architecture
description: Designed a Proof of Concept (PoC) for multi-site interconnection using SD-WAN and MPLS. Deployed critical services and implemented advanced security protocols.

title: Project Automation
description: Automating a manual task on a production line. Enhanced an industrial gluing prototype by applying mathematical modeling and risk analysis (FMEA). Achieved improved precision and reliability in the production process.

title: Projet Intelligence Artificielle
description: Data cleaning for quality assurance and exploratory analysis to identify trends. Predicted motivational factors using supervised models (Random Forest, XGBoost) and segmented employees into behavioral groups with K-means clustering. Results evaluated with metrics like AUC-ROC and F1-score.

title: Walter Protocol Bridge
description: Built functional bridges between protocols based on prototypes, and RFID documentation.

title: Optimisation of Delivery Routes
description: The design and implementation of a solution algorithm (Python), and an experimental study on the performance of the solution.

title: Healthcare Data Warehouse
description: Designed a high-performance Data Warehouse for medical data analysis. Deployed an ETL pipeline and visualized key insights using Power BI to optimize decision-making processes.

title: Virtualia V4
description: Upgrade from V3 desktop version to V4 web version

title: Easy Save
description: Designed an application with a modern MVVM architecture using .NET Core. Collaborated in Agile sprints to ensure timely delivery.
